# Selected upstream adaptations

No complete upstream repository, executable, installer, model weights or benchmark
dataset is vendored. Pins and exact source files are in the eight-entry master
implementation matrix. Review/reference is not claimed as full integration.

- Ruflo, copyright2024–2026 ruvnet, MIT: restriction algebra (tool intersection,
  shortened expiry, fixed actor) adapted in orchestration/planning_policy.py.
  EZO changes: planning-only, no grant issuance, delegation, bridge or execution.
  Full MIT text retained in RUFLO_LICENSE.txt.
- REA, MIT root: prerequisite/authority distinction adapted into availability
  reporting and fail-closed Linux-only companion admission. No debugger/capture/
  Windows authority code or bundled tools copied. Full root text in REA_LICENSE.txt.
- Microsoft JARVIS, copyright Microsoft Corporation, MIT root: structured tool
  instructions, arithmetic-tool pattern and tool graph/dependency concepts adapted
  with EZO Decimal bounds/typed registry/DAG validation. No upstream function body,
  downloader, TaskBench dataset or agent execution code copied. Full MIT text in
  JARVIS_LICENSE.txt. README Apache badges are recorded as an unresolved component
  licensing discrepancy, not ignored as a license grant.
- OpenJarvis contributors, Apache-2.0: typed tool interfaces, trace step/outcome,
  signed manifest/local-first concepts adapted in EZO calculation receipts and
  fixed-operation companion messages. EZO changes: owner-scoped existing SQL audit,
  hashes rather than raw conversation/tool content, no automatic memory, no local
  model, no generic shell/code/file API, no upstream scheduler or installer. Full
  Apache-2.0 text in OPENJARVIS_LICENSE.txt; no root NOTICE found at inspected pin.
- Existing LlamaIndex TextNode use preserves LLAMAINDEX_LICENSE.txt. VoiceStudio
  AGPL source/model weights are not copied. Supabase remains HTTP/PostgreSQL
  integration; full upstream stack not copied. APEX UI adoption is Antigravity's
  owned deliverable; no new frontend code is added in this candidate.
